messages:
maria.terrace: FYI a customer (AcmeCorp) opened an urgent ticket — lots of 504s and 5xx from hosted inference during peak burst.
samir.ops: can you paste sample logs / customer request IDs? severity P1?
maria.terrace: severity P1 from support. sample request id: req_20260317_01. Customer reports timeouts ~30s then 504s, spikes at ~09:14 UTC. Attaching a short snippet from their proxy:
```
[09:14:03] upstream request failed: context deadline exceeded, backend=redwood-gateway
[09:14:03] gateway -> 504 for tenant acmecorp, queue_wait=21s, scaleup_pending=true
```
jess.support: they also mentioned auth retries and intermittent 502s earlier. billing shows tokens accepted but some auth service 401->retry loops.
kevin.sre: initial glance: scale-up lag. Metrics: KEDA scaler frequency hit, but HPA didn't increase replicas until ~18s later. Looks like readiness probe warmup failing on model init causing longer container Ready time.
samir.ops: do we have the KEDA annotations for this tenant? last deploy changed scaledobject thresholds 3 days ago.
maria.terrace: tenant annotation: `keda.scaleTrigger.threshold=50` and minReplicaCount=0 (yikes)
kevin.sre: minReplicaCount=0 explains coldstart + queueing. Also noticed heartbeat exporter dropped tokens during a credential rotation window 09:10-09:12. Some scaler heartbeats didn't get to controller, so KEDA thought usage below threshold briefly and then saw a huge jump -> thundering scale request.
oncall-sre: @kevin.sre what's root cause: misconfig vs bug?
kevin.sre: mix of misconfig + rotation bug. Sequence:
 1) Min replicas set to 0 for cost reasons
 2) Token rotation caused temporary drop in scaler metrics to controller
 3) KEDA/HPA then saw spike, triggered scale up, but pods hit slow model init (weights load), readiness probe failing until ~25s -> requests stuck in queue -> gateway 504s.
samir.ops: repro steps to validate locally?
kevin.sre: repro:
```
# simulate cold tenant with minReplica=0
kubectl apply -f scaledobject-acme.yaml
# send burst requests
for i in {1..80}; do curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate?model=x-large & done
# watch HPA/KEDA metrics
kubectl get hpa -w
kubectl logs -n serving deploy/model-runtime -f
```
maria.terrace: got a customer-acceptable mitigation? they asked for immediate workaround.
jess.support: Customer asked for quick mitigation: reduce 504s now, will accept short degraded throughput.
kevin.sre: immediate mitigations we can do now:
 - bump minReplicaCount to 1 for acmecorp scaledobject (prewarm)
 - temporarily enable reserved capacity / emergency quota for their tenant
 - add short-term rate-limiting on their route to smooth bursts
 - deploy a low-memory warmup image (faster init) as a canary fallback model
I can apply bump now, takes ~30s for kube to ensure one pod running.
maria.terrace: please do bump + leave note to revert. Also open support ticket with timeline.
kevin.sre: applying now: `kubectl patch scaledobject acme-acmecorp -p '{"spec":{"minReplicaCount":1}}'` -> deploy-bot: scaledobject/acme-acmecorp patched (09:17 UTC)
deploy-bot: new replica set triggered, creating 1 pod.
kevin.sre: monitoring logs — pod started, model init log shows large weight file fetching from model-store; init completed at 09:18:05.
samir.ops: any permanent fix suggestions?
kevin.sre: recommendations:
 - enforce minReplicaCount=1 for tenants above X qps in onboarding rules
 - add a prewarm toggle in control plane to spin one pod before predicted bursts
 - patch heartbeat exporter to queue metrics during token rotation and send aggregated delta (prevent transient drop)
 - tune readiness probe to reflect model init semantics (differentiate network pulls vs actual runtime readiness)
 - consider faster warm paths: smaller warmup snapshot or lazy weight streaming
jess.support: I'll update customer: applied prewarm (minReplica=1) and added emergency reserved capacity. asked to monitor.
maria.terrace: can we create an internal runbook for this pattern (keda + minReplica=0 + token rotation)?
oncall-sre: yes, create runbook and action items. Assign owners.
kevin.sre: creating GH issue: infra/issue#1429 (prewarm + heartbeat fix). will include repro steps and logs.
samir.ops: owner suggestions: kevin for patch + maria to own runbook + jess for customer comms.
maria.terrace: doing postmortem blameless doc after 24h.
jess.support: customer confirmed 504s dropped to near-zero after prewarm, will close if stable.
kevin.sre: long-term: scheduled change to onboarding policy to prevent minReplica=0 for production tenants. I'll draft proposal.
maria.terrace: thanks team. if any more 5xx pop, ping this thread.
note: This thread documents an incident where autoscaling + auth rotation + cold-start model init caused gateway 5xx/504s and the immediate mitigations taken. Contains repro commands and planned follow-ups.
